jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded **Finance Executive** with proven experience in the **construction, contracting, real estate development industry** within the UAE. The ideal candidate will possess strong financial analysis skills, a thorough understanding of project-based accounting, and the ability to support business profitability through data-driven financial insights. A valid **UAE Driving License** is mandatory, as the role may require visits to project sites, clients, and company offices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
* Monitor and analyze company financial performance, budgets, and cash flow.
* Assist in preparing management reports, variance analysis, and financial forecasts.
* Monitor project costs, revenues, and profitability.
* Analyze project budgets against actual expenditures and identify cost overruns.
* Coordinate with Project Managers and Commercial Teams regarding project financial performance.
* Review subcontractor invoices, progress claims, and payment certifications.
* Conduct financial feasibility studies for new projects and business opportunities.
* Provide recommendations to improve financial efficiency and project profitability
* Monitor project collections and payment schedules.
* Assist in managing banking relationships and financing requirements.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, UAE regulations, and financial controls.
* Monitor contract compliance and financial risks associated with projects.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field.
* Professional qualifications such as **ACCA, CMA, CPA, or CA Inter** will be an advantage.

Experience

* Minimum **4-7 years of UAE experience** in finance and accounting.
* Mandatory experience in **construction, contracting, infrastructure, or real estate development companies**.
* Strong exposure to project accounting, cost control, budgeting, and financial analysis.
* Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Commercial mindset with the ability to evaluate business opportunities and project profitability.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial modeling skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Mandatory Requirements

* UAE construction/contracting industry experience.
* UAE working experience.
* Valid UAE Driving License.
* Strong financial analysis and commercial acumen.
* Ability to travel to project sites when required.

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst - Corporate Finance (Oil & Gas)
jobs.description:
**Business Unit:**

Corporate Finance

**Industry:**

Oil & Gas

**Overview**

Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.

**Corporate Finance**

The Houlihan Lokey Corporate Finance business has extensive expertise in mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, activist shareholder and takeover defense, and other related advisory services for a broad range of clients. In addition, we have the proven ability to engineer and execute financing solutions that are essential for growth and success and offer access to financing in the public and alternative capital markets through the issuance of debt, equity, or hybrid securities. In EMEA, we work with a wide spectrum of companies, from middle-market privately owned enterprises to large multinational organizations. With a growing platform of Corporate Finance professionals and offices across the region, in addition to our global reach and in-depth knowledge across a broad range of industries, we have the breadth and targeted expertise to provide exceptional client service.

**Energy Group**

Houlihan Lokey’s Oil & Gas (O&G) Group is a recognized leader in providing a wide range of investment banking advisory services to companies and investors operating in the Oil & Gas industry. This dedicated team of financial and technical professionals focuses primarily on large, complex transactions in the Oil & Gas industry, including across the upstream, midstream, and downstream sectors as well as in molecule-related alternative energies. The O&G Group is comprised of a global team with dedicated industry bankers in Houston, Dallas, New York, London, Dubai, and Hong Kong and regularly works on cross-border deals. The O&G Group is a cross-product industry vertical.

### **Scope**

### **The Oil & Gas team at Houlihan Lokey is looking to add a Senior Financial Analyst in Dubai.** **The environment at Houlihan Lokey is both collegial and entrepreneurial. Teamwork is essential to the firm’s success. At the same time, creativity and new ideas are encouraged. Analysts are given substantial responsibility and are encouraged to help us grow our business.** **Analysts work on transactions that provide exposure to various investment banking services, including M&A, private placements of debt and equity, refinancings, and leveraged buyouts.**

### **Responsibilities**

As a Senior Financial Analyst, you will:

  

* Prepare, analyze and help explain historical and projected financial information
* Create financial models
* Coordinate and perform business due diligence
* Prepare confidential information memoranda, management presentations, marketing pitches and other presentations
* Conduct research on sectors, companies and potential buyers
* Value companies and businesses
* Build relationships and maintain direct contact with clients and prospective clients and professional advisors
* Supervise and train junior staff members
* Assist in planning of engagements

The environment at Houlihan Lokey is collegial and entrepreneurial and, as such, rewards staff with substantial responsibility and interaction with senior-level professionals and clients. Analysts are given substantial responsibility and are encouraged to help us grow our business

### **Requirements / Qualifications**

The ideal candidate thinks strategically, is motivated, detail oriented, creative, outgoing, and possesses excellent quantitative skills. If you have the following qualifications & experience, we’d love to hear from you:

  

* Strong Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* 2-3 years of investment banking experience within either an M&A, generalist or Industry team. Experience/knowledge in the Oil & Gas sector will be favourably regarded
* Demonstrable experience in executing sell-side transactions

* Strong Excel and financial modelling skills
* Strong analytical abilities and knowledge of accounting and applied financial theory
* Excellent understanding of financial statements analysis with the ability to work through key assumptions, implicit caveats, and limitations
* An excellent understanding of financial valuation theory, methodologies, and applications
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to work cooperatively with team members
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple projects and hit deadlines in a highly organised manner
* An independent, solutions-focused mind-set
* An exceptional work ethic

*Note to External Recruiters / Search Firms: Houlihan Lokey does not accept unsolicited resumes and will not pay for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume. Any unsolicited resumes received will not be considered as a valid submission*

***We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.***
